dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to get that fellow out? This is giving me a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can do?

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Hm? Oh! A kind adventurer, what good timing.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Here's the thing. There used to be a tunnel here that led north, but it collapsed recently after some sort of anomaly with the kuuvahki.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Thankfully no one was hurt, but a traveling merchant from overseas claims his "companion" is trapped inside...

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: It's a Slothsheep he met and befriended around here. Stay in these parts long enough and you'll notice that Slothsheep usually follow people just to scatter the seeds they're carrying.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: But no matter how we explained it, that gentleman just wouldn't listen. He insisted we find a way to rescue it.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: To reconnect the path leading deeper into the cave, we'd have to use these Intricate Blooms. The problem is that I can't use the Frostmoon Scions' magic, and I don't have any kuuvahki devices strong enough for the job...

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Luckily you came by. If anyone can get that Slothsheep out of there, it would be an adventurer like you, right?

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: I'll thank you on behalf of that gentleman.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: If anyone can get that Slothsheep out of there, it would be an adventurer like you, right? I'll thank you on behalf of that gentleman.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Wonderful. I knew you'd think of something!

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Slothsheep can't live outside regions with kuuvahki, but at the very least, it might offer that gentleman a bit of comfort during his stay in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: I'll take my leave now. Here's a little something to show our gratitude...

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Oh, isn't this the companion of that foreign trader lost in the cave? So you managed to bring it out after all.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: We all know the Slothsheep follows you around to scatter the seeds it's carrying farther away, but that gentleman wouldn't believe it, no matter how we explained.

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Honestly, I wasn't sure how to deal with all that. Good thing I ran into a helpful adventurer like you, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: Here, just a little something to say thanks...
